text:
sania: Quick idea for onboarding: a lightweight 'ingest patch proxy' that emits small patches (token remap, header) instead of always materializing normalized binaries. Saves storage and keeps ingest fast. Thoughts?

liam: Sounds promising. How do we ensure runtime latency if a patch needs to be applied at load-time?

zara: LRU cache of rehydrated artifacts on serving nodes + pre-warm when a model is promoted or first-served. For critical enterprise customers, offer an option to materialize on ingest.

adele: We still need to catch semantic regressions. Propose staged probes: cheap CPU smoke for all, GPU micro-run when CPU flags or model size > threshold.

mike: Agree on tiered probes. Also recommend a small quantized CPU runtime for quicker top-k overlap checks to avoid GPU churn.

ops-bot: Note: current ingest concurrency is 12. If mass rehydrate events happen, we'll see spikes. Suggest burst queue + backoff and prioritized orgs.

liam: Tokenizer mismatches: compute a deterministic tokenizer signature (vocab+specials) and produce an inline remap patch plus reversible mapping for replay. If remap changes generation ordering beyond epsilon, label as "semantic-risk" and require manual review.

sania: We'll record a manifest with checksums + token_sig + patch refs + probe summary. Runtime reads header first to pick routing (reject, patch-on-load, or fallback).

zara: Minimal metrics for gating: top1/top5 overlap, logprob-delta on gold tokens, p50/p95 latency delta. Keep thresholds configurabe per org.

adele: Rule engine for compatibility decisions: YAML rules with ordered predicates -> action (FAIL/WARN/AUTO-FIX). Environment- and org-scoped.

liam: Sketch manifest snippet: {manifest_v:2, model:org/x, files:[weights,tokenizer], sha256s:[...], token_sig:tokv2, patches:[tok-remap], sanity:{cpu_probe:true, top5:0.92}}

mike: Canary plan: start internal, run shadow traffic through patched and raw runtimes for 24-72h, compare metrics, auto-rollback on drift.

sania: Ops notes: materialization-on-demand requires registry changes and audit trails. We'll default to internal-only visibility for probe outputs.

ops-bot: Reminder: storage could increase if we materialize widely. Estimate +5-8% unless lazy patches used.

zara: Next steps: Adele prototypes tokenizer fingerprint + reversible remapper. Liam builds rule-engine YAML draft. I'll author canary runbook and thresholds. Sania will draft the ingest-patch-proxy API. Reconvene in 48h. :rocket:
